en.bdb: A dog of the Guru's court

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੈਲੀ ਦੀ ਦਰਗਾਹ ਦਾ ਕੁਤਾ ਮਜਨੂੰ ਦੇਖਿ ਲੁਭਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: lailee dhee dharagaeh dhaa kutaa majanoo(n) dhekh lubhaanaa|

en.bdb: Beholding the dog of Laild's house, Majana was charmed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਤੇ ਦੀ ਪੈਰੀਂ ਪਵੈ ਹੜਿ ਹੜਿ ਹਸੈ ਲੋਕ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: kute dhee pairee(n) pavai haR haR hasai lok viddaanaa|

en.bdb: He fell at the feet of dog seeing which people laughed roaringly.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੀਰਾਸੀ ਮੀਰਾਸੀਆਂ ਨਾਮ ਧਰੀਕੁ ਮੁਰੀਦ ਬਿਬਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: meeraasee meeraaseeaa(n) naam dhareek mureedh bibaanaa|

en.bdb: Out of (Muslim) bards one bard became disciple of Baia (Nanak).

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਤਾ ਡੂਮ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਕੁਤਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੁਤਿਆਂ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: kutaa ddoom vakhaaneeaai kutaa vich kutiaa(n) nimaanaa|

en.bdb: His companions called him a dog-bard, even among dogs a lowly one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਆਸਕ ਸਬਦ ਦੇ ਕੁਤੇ ਦਾ ਪੜਕੁਤਾ ਭਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: gursikh aasak sabadh dhe kute dhaa paRakutaa bhaanaa|

en.bdb: TheSikhs of the Guru who were suitors of the Word (the Brhm) took a fancy to that so-called dog of dogs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਟਨਿ ਚਟਨਿ ਕੁਤਿਆਂ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਧੋਹੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗਸਤ ਕਮਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: kaTan chaTan kutiaa(n) moh na dhoh dhiragasat kamaanaa|

en.bdb: Biting and licking is the nature of dogs but they have no infatuation, treachery or cursedness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਵਗੁਣਿਆਰੇ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਰਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: avaguniaare gun karan gurmukh saadhasa(n)gat kurabaanaa|

en.bdb: The gurmukhs are sacrifice unto the holy congregation because it is benevolent even to the evil and wicked persons.
Holy congregation is known for its reputation as uplifter of the fallen ones.
